merged.title: feat(launcher): new OpenRAC logo, smoother pages, branch updates and an Android set-up fix
merged.author: mateuszklysz
merged.untrustedBody:
## Description

Up to date with master (merged again after the latest master commit). The new OpenRAC logo comes to the launcher, its icons and the Android game. Page changes are smooth now, a fork's launcher can follow any of its branches, development releases in CI are fixed, and the docs are shorter.

## Changelog

### Logo and icons
- New logo (the lombax mark and the name) in the header and on the welcome screen, as a sharp vector. It sits level with the bar's text, and only fades in once at start (it no longer tilts on hover).
- The logo's tracing leftovers are cleaned out, and the "C" ends in a straight cut, everywhere it appears.
- New app icons from the logo mark for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
- In the Android game, the side panel's header shows the full logo instead of the word "OpenRAC". The on-screen button that opens the panel shows the logo's mark, styled and sized like the other buttons.

### Header and look
- A 50 px header with a quiet striped back

merged.title: fix(rac1): hoverboard girl grows; list new differences
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
Joint modifier scale was dropped on joints without a scale key, so the hoverboard girl never grew.
Differences from the original now list the pause-load guard and the remembered language and sound.

merged.title: docs(rac1): remembered language and sound in differences
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
Differences from the original now list the remembered language and Sound page.
The port keeps them between runs; a loaded save keeps the player's options.

merged.title: fix(rac1): load from pause flight matches the console
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
initialize_level_runtime wrote 0x100000 to D_00160000+0x100C, which the port moved to the wrong word in a level.
space.c now names D_0016100C, so the flight matches PCSX2 (0x100000, then 0xA0000) and the boot.c wrap is gone.

merged.title: feat(launcher): import saves from PCSX2
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
The game's menu gets Import saves from PCSX2: it reads a .ps2 card file or a folder card.
The game's save folder is copied onto OpenRAC's card after a backup, and the saves list reloads.

merged.title: fix(launcher): Android disc set-up works again, says why it fails, and offers Rebuild
merged.author: mateuszklysz
merged.untrustedBody:
## Description

On Android a game set up from its disc could not be played, a `.chd` failed with no message, and a refused disc said only "Activity has what it printed". This fixes all three and adds Rebuild.

## Changelog

### Setting up from your disc
- Errors from the disc picker (Set up from your disc, and Android's games folder) show as a toast instead of nothing.
- A failed set-up shows the extractor's own reason, for example "The image is not a version of this game that OpenRAC knows (…)", in one toast instead of two.
- A CHD is also recognised by its first bytes, so one the picker hands over without `.chd` in its name is unpacked too.
- A CHD the picker streams, rather than opening it as a file, is copied first and unpacked from the copy. Free space is checked for both, and the copy is removed afterwards.
- A plain image picked without `.iso` in its name is kept with it.
- A CHD made with `chdman createcd` is read too, not only one made with `createdvd`. Its first d

merged.title: fix(rac1): vendor icons after an in-level movie
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
The movie's RAM park into GS memory covered the HUD textures, so vendor icons went blank.
The port's player never uses that RAM, so the park and the read-back now skip image transfers.

merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
The title (99) and flight (98) scenes have no collision.glb, so their bake failed at the end.
They are now planned from their authored volumes, with no moby seeds or geometry coverage.

merged.untrustedBody:
Play brings the mods only with the Mods switch under it on (off by default); it replaces Play with mods and Purist mode.
The Mods tab is for adding and setting up mods; the 0.9.0 notes say so.

merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
On a Steam Deck the webview runs without accelerated compositing, and opening a page crashed it in a view transition.
The page slides are now off wherever WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE is set.

merged.untrustedBody:
The ship scenes attach the mask through hook slot func_001E97D0 (NTSC 001E9450), missing from level_hooks.
Added both slots; on Gemlik Ratchet now wears the mask when boarding the ship.

Correct two measured callable entries in the catalogue generator while keeping their canonical names and original ends:

- `func_002C38A0`: skip the preceding 8 bytes; catalogue body 64 -> 56 bytes.
- `func_00335918`: skip the preceding 32 bytes; catalogue body 68 -> 36 bytes.

Apply the corrections to the boot and all 27 level copies in USA v1.01, USA v2.00 and PAL (168 function placements). Identify the original full extents before shortening, then retain the proven boot pairing when the shortened code is identical to another boot method. Replay validates that pairing and rejects unexpected extents.

Regenerate all six catalogues with the normal primary generator and cross-release carry tool. Repeating each generation produces identical output. Only the two intended rows change in each table; source definitions, names and all other catalogue entries remain unchanged. Add synthetic regression tests and reconcile the existing blocker and nonmatching notes.

merged.title: fix(catalogue): repair measured entries across all three releases
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Repair 216 additional catalogue entries across USA v1.01, USA v2.00 and PAL (1,854 placements), preserving canonical names, kinds, placement sets and original ends. The rules cover 114 primary identities plus 21 USA v2.00 and 81 PAL identities. All affected placements have a positive entry witness; the excluded prefixes remain assembly.

Remove 17 individually checked one-word remnants from the catalogues and their obsolete `INCLUDE_ASM` markers. The 613 affected placements follow completed returns or a closed tail jump, with no measured static incoming references. Selection is by name and size; identical unrelated instructions are retained.

Keep existing identities stable through full/short-body collisions and repeat generation. Add `tools/carry.py --version VERSION --entries` to repair established release catalogues without full realignment, source generation, new callee correspondence claims or C promotion. Normal carry behavior is unchanged.

merged.title: feat(src): classify 27 proven original-assembly bodies
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Classify 27 additional original-assembly bodies as `ASM_FUNC` across 990 applicable placements in USA v1.01, USA v2.00 and PAL. Source changes are only marker substitutions: all 4,863 C definitions and all catalogue entries remain unchanged. The rebuilt images retain the original assembly.

Each classified placement has an external entry witness and a decoded, reachable instruction outside the qualified plain-C output. Control flow includes real delay slots and excludes literals after returns or behind unconditional branches. A generic MMI opcode, `por` register copying/zeroing, `lq`/`sq`, `ldl`/`ldr`, `mult1` or `madd` is not a classification rule.

The original-assembly classification follows AGENTS.md's instruction-based criterion with maintainer authorization. It does not claim the historical source was necessarily a separate assembler file rather than mixed C/assembly.
